decisions.decision: Entity-Component composition: Entity has List<IComponent>, systems query components
decisions.rationale: Lightweight, no ECS framework dependency, sufficient for scope.

decisions.decision: System font rendering via content pipeline (.spritefont) using Arial size 24
decisions.rationale: MonoGame's SpriteFont provides efficient glyph rendering. Arial size 24 fits 32px tiles.

decisions.decision: Tiles rendered as colored rectangle background (15% alpha) + glyph character centered via DrawString
decisions.rationale: Provides clear roguelike aesthetic with visible glyph shapes on colored tile backgrounds.

decisions.decision: Pinned MonoGame NuGet packages to 3.8.2.1105 for content pipeline compatibility
decisions.rationale: MonoGame 3.8.4.1 dotnet-mgcb tool has assembly resolution issue with FontDescription type.

decisions.decision: Game1.Instance singleton for scene management access from scenes
decisions.rationale: Enables scenes to push/pop transitions without tight coupling.

decisions.decision: Movement uses keyboard state polling with prev-state edge detection
decisions.rationale: One press = one action, prevents held-key repeat in turn-based game.

decisions.decision: Bump-to-attack: pressing direction into an enemy triggers melee attack
decisions.rationale: Standard roguelike convention — intuitive and requires no extra key modifier.

decisions.decision: Perlin noise with 4 height octaves + 3 moisture octaves for biome generation
decisions.rationale: Multi-octave noise produces natural-looking terrain with varied biome transitions.

decisions.decision: 10 biomes mapped from (height, moisture): deep water, shallow, sand, plains, forest, hills, mountains, swamp, tundra, desert
decisions.rationale: Covers most terrain types expected in a fantasy roguelike overworld.

decisions.decision: World generates on OverworldScene.LoadContent with random seed
decisions.rationale: Each game starts with a unique world. Seed-based for reproducibility.
